subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `deferred` as a cron run status and promote parent lifecycle events through the public plugin SDK?
rationale: The underlying bug needs repair, but these two choices expand persisted, protocol, CLI/UI, and third-party plugin contracts beyond an internal lifecycle correction.

options.title: Approve both public contracts
options.body: Keep `deferred` and the SDK callback, then require compatibility coverage and fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Preserve the yielded-parent fix while removing the new public status and SDK surface to minimize long-term compatibility obligations.

recommendation.title: Approve both public contracts
recommendation.body: Keep `deferred` and the SDK callback, then require compatibility coverage and fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership spans the affected agent lifecycle, Discord progress, and cron UI surfaces, making this the best available routing candidate for the cross-product contract choice.
